rules.name: Upgrade interface without UI component
rules.message: Upgrade interface/type defined but no corresponding UI component or scene found
rules.suggestion: Create an UpgradeScreen class or component that renders upgrade selection from these types

rules.name: Game state class without save/load methods
rules.message: GameState class has no save/load/serialize/deserialize methods — no persistence
rules.suggestion: Add save() and load() methods using localStorage or IndexedDB

rules.name: requestAnimationFrame loop without delta time parameter
rules.message: requestAnimationFrame callback doesn't compute delta time from timestamp — frame-rate dependent physics
rules.suggestion: Compute dt = (timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000 in the rAF callback and pass to update()

rules.name: Canvas render without clearRect
rules.message: Canvas drawImage without clearRect — will draw over previous frames (smearing)
rules.suggestion: Call ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height) before drawing each frame
